title: docs: update README — 2026-09-22
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: The README blooms again
gist.blurb: The project front porch got its daily sweep: fresh news, refreshed recent apps, and an updated map of the ever-growing star garden.
gist.summary: Refreshed the README’s Latest News and Recent Apps sections and updated the light and dark GitHub star-history charts through 2026-09-22.
gist.impact: Visitors can see current project news, newly published community apps, and the latest repository growth history directly from the README.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny librarian-gardener updating a cozy open-source noticeboard: fresh app cards and a star-shaped growth chart are pinned among flowering code-plants. A small CRT monitor robot can hold the refreshed chart, while lime-green leaves and stars make the repository’s growth feel alive.

Code-flowers and lime green (#ecf874) vines bloom around the board on a warm cream and pastel lavender background; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with small pixel-font text: 'LATEST NEWS'.
